text_block_list.text: October—on that day, a bizarre sight unfolded at Tokyo Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable!! It's just like a GⅠ race!
Look at this incredible crowd!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Considering the lineup of runners,
its prestige might as well be on par with a GⅠ.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
After all, Silence Suzuka-san,
who's in top form right now, is in the race.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, there's Grass Wonder-san, dubbed 'The Monster,'and El Condor Pasa-san, hailed by many
as the strongest in the Classic Class—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Aaaah... Getting to see a race like this makes me so glad I became an Umamusume fan~.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Suzuka, Grass, El—
they're all my friends!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'll cheer everyone on with all my might!

And so, watched over by countless fans,
the race began—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder chases desperately, but she's struggling to find her stride!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa is closing in fast, but the gap just won't shrink!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Silence Suzuka! It's Silence Suzuka!
Never yielding the lead, she reaches the GOOOAAAL!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Every one of Silence Suzuka-san's races
leaves a huge impression on those who watch.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
She was running so far out in front,
yet she got another boost at the very end...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Why, Suzuka's running is so mysterious, desu.
"That must be the running style that Silence Suzuka found for herself."

Her distinct running style was one that truly
left a lasting impression in the hearts of all who watched—
